title: Cops Discover Missing Boy’s Body in Garbage Can
description:
Sushi Staples, 37, lied to police when they went to her home to investigate a call about her 10-year-old son. Staples insisted she only had daughters when Rock Island Police asked about her son, Zion. Police returned with a warrant to search her home and interrogated Staples at her kitchen table. Find out what happened next on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
